ADHD-200 CC400 Subcortical Atlas

Source: R/data.R
adhd200_400_subcortical.Rd

Subcortical parcellation from the Craddock CC400 clustering.

Usage

adhd200_400_subcortical()

Value

A ggseg.formats::ggseg_atlas object (subcortical).

References

Craddock RC, et al. (2012). Human Brain Mapping, 33(8):1914-1928. doi:10.1002/hbm.21333

See also

Other ggseg_atlases: adhd200_200_cortical(), adhd200_200_subcortical(), adhd200_400_cortical(), craddock200_cortical(), craddock200_subcortical()

Other subcortical_atlases: adhd200_200_subcortical(), craddock200_subcortical()

Examples

adhd200_400_subcortical()
#>
